item.title: Patch now: WordPress Core: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
item.description:
WordPress Core: exploited from day 0 · fix: 4.7.39, 4.8.34, 4.9.35 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update WordPress Core to the fixed version for your release line (for example 4.7.39, 4.8.34 or 4.9.35).

WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-119977
